summary: Validate rows before a bulk import
description:
Bulk imports accept a CSV of orders and write them in one go. Today a bad row fails the whole import halfway through.

Acceptance criteria
• Every row is validated before anything is written
• The response lists each invalid row with its line number and reason
• Valid files import exactly as before

comments.author: Ana Costa
comments.body: Can we also cover empty files? Support saw a 500 on an empty upload this morning.

comments.author: Sam Rivera
comments.body: Plan: validate in a first pass, collect errors, then write. PR coming.

comments.author: Lee Park
comments.body: Priority bumped: two customers hit this during month-end.
